name: EPIC 249141305
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 8.7 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,608 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.96 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,650 K at its surface.
